column4: cleat#2911 G2: MySQL-ONLY by subject, so it skips as ONE test rather than per dialect -- the defect is a MySQL session time_zone biasing a TIMESTAMP column's round trip through the Go driver, and PostgreSQL's timestamptz and MSSQL's datetimeoffset carry their own offset on the wire and never had it. The gate is a plain os.Getenv("CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL") check at the top of the function (it opens its own *sql.DB with a non-UTC session appended to the DSN, so it cannot go through forEachBackend/registeredBackends the way the rest of this file's tests do), so the whole test skips -- one skip, not three, and not a subtest. Guards against a MySQL session whose time_zone is not UTC silently extending the idempotency-key replay retention window (measured 2h at +02:00 before the fix), which would let the engine resend a call under a key the service may have already forgotten.
